note: One list for both layers. internal/config (CPUBackendRefusal, ScreenExtraArgs) and render/igpu-engine.mjs (refuseCpuBackend, screenExtraArgs) must agree on every row; both test files read this file. Strings are JSON, so the unicode spaces are escapes. Go's \s is [\t\n\f\r ] (no vertical tab, no unicode space) and JS's \s has both, so extra_args_refused carries a vertical-tab row (u000b) next to the unicode-space ones. go_stricter is the ONE known difference, in the safe direction: U+0085 (NEL) splits an element in Go but not in JS, so the Go screen refuses it and the Node screen passes it (the Go layer refuses first; the runner is its own door for a hand-run). Each test file asserts its own side of that list, so a change on either side is deliberate.
